items.title: Joseph "Fan" Bourgeau Interview, 1972-09-13
items.q: Me and his wife, Miss Alexander, she was a piano player.

ctx.x: You were talking about some band? Huh? You were talking about some band there? Well, I got lost on who was in the band. Where? Just then, before you were talking about Leroy.

Oh, Peter Alexander. Yeah. Me and his wife, Miss Alexander, she was a piano player. Right. And then Pico, he was clarinet player. Oh, yeah. We used to play all in Vic Harvey, all around. All around there. Four-piece band. And that music used to sound so good too, man. Pico, good clarinet player. Did you know George Jones? George Jones? Yeah. George Jones, the bass player? Mm-hmm. Yeah, do I know him? He never could play no bass. He was more of a jive, you know? George Jones, yeah, I played with him a couple…
The horses? Yeah, what they call horses. People would make the horse sound. Yeah, I wonder 25.
